story: An enterprise lead is qualified by the AI and closes on a booked meeting with a person. The meeting is the hand-off; the conversation is never taken from the AI before it (owner decision 2026-09-27; the old engine escalated READY_TO_BUY on the last turn).

turns.lead: We're looking at options to consolidate reporting across our sites.
The problem is every site reports differently and the board can't compare them.
Success would be one weekly report the board trusts.
About 400 staff across four sites. This sounds promising: can we book a call with your team next week?
I'm the finance director, and our board signs off after a pilot.
